content: Nyi tabab yidaak, yitaypika pris awa nuwukadiy sapakwa nyanugwawa Sisariyaar yidiy. Dayawa duw nak, dikidi si Titalas, maaj lakwudi duw yad. Day van tidi duw Piylik dikik wulakuw, day ata wadaad daya maaj Polak.

Pol yakuw, Titalas kitawa van tidi duwak wadid Polak, “Min mwiya nimadi duw-adimin. Min nyanak yara van tikwanadimin. Adiy tayir jawjaay kwurbadiy jaav min sukwasukw kwurmin, nyan aka yara kwanadiyan.
“Nyan ababa tipaam nyanyi rakarak tinadiyan minak, min adiy jaav kwurminilik tikuw.
“Nyan minak kilim simiy kwurin kwu maa majik. Aw nyan minak kwasa maaj wanaak.
“Nyan lakwubana kidi duw di jaal dakwanaad. Juw dayadiy nyidim ababa tipaar di yitaay wadakilib wariya-kwanadiy. Di adiy Nasarit bapa duw taakw dayadi yitaypika duwad.
“Di God dikidi wiyak jawjaay kwurik tikuw, nyan kalakwubaad. [Nyan dim nyana lo wak kotiy ik. Aw Lisiyas, adiy vay sawdiy duw dayadi yitaypika duw yakuw, nyanaam viyakuw, ata nyigildid.
“Lisiyas ata waad nyan kilir yakinadiyan minak.] Min kidi duwak bas sikimina, min mina wukikimina ababa javik wabanadimin dikik.”
Nuwukadiy Juw dayabab maa wakuw Polak, wadiy, “Kidiy maaj abab mwiya maajadiy.”
Piylik Pol diki maaj ata wukidil.
Adi van tidi duw yaakiya wadik, Pol maaj ata wadil. Pol ata waad, “Wun lakwutuwa min nyanak nabiy samasam van timinidiy. Alik wun minak watuwalik wunadiy kwurtuwdiy yawiyik, rakarak tinadiwun.
“Li min nuwukadiy duwak bas sikimina, min wukikimina wun Jiruwsalimaar yidiwun Godak gaba maaj sukwuk. Aka nyi tabatiy maan vitiy tituwdiy.
“God dikidi wiyaam wun maaj awarwa maa warjuw. Dayadiy gaba maja wiyaam niki tamiy Jiruwsalimaam ab, wun duw takwak maa wu day wariyadakik. Kibir javik day maa vi.
“Kidiy suwala maaj dayadiy maaw day minak simakak simakak maa rav.

“Ki niki jaav aal bwutaay kwurtuwil. Kidiy Juw maa wanadiy Jisas dikidi bapa duw takwak. Aw wun adi bapaam tikuw, Jisas diki sukw ab kwakwanadiwun. Wun nyanadiy warag dayadi Godak gaba maaj sukwu-nadiwun. Aw wun wukijibir tinadiwun ababa jaav Mawsis diki lo waam tinadiy, ababa jaav adiy God diki maaj wasapwiydiy duw sukwudadiyik ab.
“Wun wukijibir tinadiwun ginyir God ababa duw taakw, adiy viyakit tinadiy adiy kupwaraap tinadiywa, di kirapitaka-kidadiy. Kidiy Juw ab ki javik wukijibir tinadiy.
“Wun nima yawiy kwurtuwil ababa kwurtuwdiy javik wun wap saay maa Godawa duw takwak.
“Nabiy samasam nuwukadiy tipaam kwakuw, wun sibinin yidiwun Jiruwsalimaar saan karaytuwdiy wunadiy bapa duw takwak. Wunabab ofa kwiyik Godak.
“Wun Mawsis diki lo wadil yawiy nyan yara tibakikik kwurkuw, God dikidi wiyaam ofa kwiytuw, day sitakira-dadiwun. Duw taakw samasam wunawa maa kwu, aw kwudiy maa.
“Aw nuwukadiy Asiya tamiyaam kwanadiy Juw day alim kwadiy. Li day maaj wakir wunak day kilir yakwadiy. Yakuw, adiy maaj wakwadiy minak.
“Tayir wun daya Kaunsil nyidim tidiwun. Day minak wakinadiy agwa vaala day sitakiradaal wunaam. Aal maa rav.
“Aw jaav naka wun dayak gaam situwdiy, ‘Wun lakwutuwa duw taakw kiyadaak, God ata kirapitaka-kidadiy. Ki javik gwur nibwul kotiy-gwuradiwun.’”

Piylik di mwiyir lakwudil Kristen dayadiy wukijibir tidadiy javik. Di vagaluwdiy duwak wadidiy, “Yaakiya, ki maaj aka kwusina. Ginyir nyanadiy vay sawdiy duw dayadi yitaypika duw, Lisiyas, kilir yadik, gwura maaj wun lakatiy-kituwa dikiwa.”
Di Polak van tidi duwak ata wadid, “Min kidi kalabus im kwanadi duwak van ada. Di wiyaam tiytiyaan tikinaad. Li dikidiy kapa duw dikik kikipaat niki jaav niki jaav karayik, ay yaakiya, maaj maa.”
Pol kip kwaad kalabus im nabiy vitiy.
Nuwukadiy nyi yidaak, Piylik diki taakw, liki si Diruwsila, liwa yaad. Diruwsila li Juw daya bapa taakwa. Di maaj wayakidil Polak. Pol yakuw, di wadibir adiy Kristen wukijibir tidadiy javik.

Kidiy javik Pol Piylikak wadidiy: viyakita sukw, duw diki kupwarapa mawul wapakwaad, ginyir God duw taakw kotiy kidadiy. Piylik di yagakuw Pol diki majik, Polak ata wadid, “Min maaya! Ginyir wuna mawul warlik, wun maaj minak wayaki-kituwa maa.”
Aw niki javik di wukid. Di wukid Pol saan dikik kwiydikik. Alik jaab samasam di maaj wayakidil Pol yaan dikiwa maaj bwuladikik.
Piylik di sukwasukw kwurik adiy Juwak. Alik tikuw, Pol kip kalabus im rad. Nabiy vitiy yibir, Pasiyas Pistas di Piylik diki tamiy kwurdil.
